name: My views
description: Your agent chats as a thread list: what needs you first, then the rest, newest first.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats: title, state, folder and times.
scopes.workspace:read: Know which workspace is open, to mark its chat.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a chat's workspace when you click its thread.
scopes.actions:run: Open a chat that has no workspace in a new tab.
